messages:
maya_csm: Heads up: HelioCare wants to onboard a customer-provided 13B 'clinical-scrubber' model for triage summaries. They insist on Private deployment, HSM-wrapped model keys, and explainability hooks (token saliency) exposed to their SREs. timeline: POC in 6 weeks.

raj_security: Need to know if model will be updated by HelioCare or if Redwood will host immutable weights. Also ask for model license and export-control info. If PHI flows in prod, BAA is mandatory.

frank_mleng: From ML: what format and tokenizer? For saliency we need gradients or attribution support; many quantized deployments strip gradients. Ask customer if they expect gradient-based saliency or attention-based approximations.

maya_csm: I asked. They said safetensors, gguf fallback, custom tokenizer. Saliency: attention-rollout is acceptable for now, but they want a toggle in POC.

olivia_engineering: Toggle needs runtime hooks — we can enable attention-rollout cheaply in the runtime, but gradient saliency requires a different path (and bigger memory). Recommend we offer attention-based saliency in POC and evaluate gradient path later. Also confirm retention policy for logs containing PHI.

raj_security: Checklist I need: signed BAA, model checksum + sha256, host location (customer-managed S3 or Redwood storage), HSM integration diagram, and retention policy.

maya_csm: HelioCare prefers Redwood to store artifacts but insists on customer-managed KMS with keywrap. They provided a sample retention policy and are comfortable with 90-day ephemeral logs.

frank_mleng: For evals ask them for 200 de-identified examples and a small set of edge-case prompts that highlight hallucination and entity masking. We'll run entity-leak and rouge/bleu-style fidelity checks.

opsbot: Capacity probe: private-cluster-eu-west has 1 A10 free slot in 4 weeks, 0 in 2 weeks. Recommend reserving slot for week 4 to meet HelioCare POC window. (probe id: cb-2391-helio) :calendar:
